source: STAR'13 Fig. 2 (dynamic flow network and time-expanded network, T=4). Not present in ICRA'13 or TOR'16.
edge_semantics: arc (u,t)->(v,t+c(e)) for every t with t+c(e) <= T (the c=0 arc s+->y is drawn vertically inside one time column); green holdover (v,t)->(v,t+1); all capacities 1; super source -> s+(0) only; s-(t) -> super sink for every t
note: The caption calls these 'forward' edges with c(e) = t' - t, but s+->y has c=0, i.e. a same-time arc; flow value is capped at 3 by the three unit arcs leaving s+(0).
